newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs steady at noon, stuck in narrow ranges.
newsitem.headline: JGBs steady at noon, stuck in narrow ranges.

text.p: The key September JGB futures contract was steady by noon on Thursday, with buying-on-dip demand from traders protecting the downwide and profit-taking interest capping the upside, traders said.
The September was at 125.02 at noon, up from Wednesday's 124.95 with turnover of a thin 11,725 contracts.
The market shunned a 2.8 percent year-on-year growth in June money supply, which was lower than the market had previously expected.
Only a modest gain on Tokyo stocks underpinned bond prices, traders said. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-3-3432-8676
